Inspect the corpus row for Kendrick Jarrell Beaird v. United States (No. 25-5343) to verify grant date, amici, counsel, and current merits status.
Check corpus entries for two prior cert petitions raising the Stinson/Kisor issue cited in the Brief in Opposition (Cortes, No. 23-5928; Boler, No. 23-7173).

notes: The provisioned snapshot and filings (petition.txt, brief-in-opposition.txt, appendix.txt, questions-presented.txt) provided complete visibility into the limited cert grant on Question 2, the Solicitor General's concession that Kisor governs Stinson, and the appointment of Anthony J. Dick as Court-appointed amicus curiae. CourtListener MCP search calls hit the shared 25/min HTTP 429 rate limit on a couple of precedent lookups, which did not affect the analysis.
